newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - October 3.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - October 3.

text.p: The Federal Reserve had two large one-day net misses in its reserve projections, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The first miss was on Thursday, when there were more reserves than anticipated due to Treasury deposits at the Fed being lower than expected.
The second miss was on Monday, when there were less reserves than anticipated due to Treasury deposits at the Fed being higher than anticipated.

As for the pattern of borrowing, about 20 percent of the adjustment borrowing for the week was done by the small banks, while about 80 percent was done by the money center banks. No borrowing was done by the large regionals.
As for the pattern of borrowing on Wednesday, all of the borrowing was done by the small banks.
The high in natural float was about $1.6 billion on Tuesday, while the low was about $550 million on Friday.
Transportation float averaged about $35 million per day with the high on Tuesday at about $100 million primarily due to air mechanical problems in Detroit and missed flights.
